description: LEClab Mining Projects is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors Michelle Li Ern Ang. This space is created for hosting the Google Earth Engine (GEE) codes used for the Didipio Mining Project. This project will be published as a research article titled: Socio-environmental land cover time series analysis of mining landscapes using Google Earth Engine and web-based mapping. Code Authors: Khanh Duc Ngo and Michelle Li Ern Ang. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2020. Formats: TXT. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC0 1.0. Caveats: written from the Dataverse search and dataset metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support industrial-facility and resource studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
